status_note: These are proposals only. Nothing below has been implemented. Choose an option for each, or ask for changes, before work starts.

suggestions.title: Add a travel-date filter
suggestions.what: Filter the schedule and hotel pages by arrival and departure dates.
suggestions.benefit: Shows only events and hotels that fit your trip.

suggestions.title: Add live hotel rate capture
suggestions.what: Record nightly rates for your dates from each operator's booking engine, with a timestamp and source link.
suggestions.benefit: Makes the true cost per night measurable.
suggestions.effort: Medium. Needs a manual or scripted process per hotel. Some booking engines may block automation.
options: Manual check, recorded in the table

suggestions.title: Add walking-time data
suggestions.what: Compute walking times between hotels and poker rooms.
suggestions.benefit: Meets the 30-minute walking requirement with checkable numbers.
suggestions.effort: Medium. Needs a map API key, which is not available in this environment.

suggestions.title: Classify each event by entry rule automatically
suggestions.what: Parse each structure sheet for re-entry, rebuy, add-on and flight rules, then flag any event not yet checked.
suggestions.benefit: Removes manual classification risk. Flags unverified events.
suggestions.effort: Medium. Structure sheets are PDFs with inconsistent layouts.

suggestions.title: Add a verification timestamp to every row
suggestions.what: Show the date each row was last checked against its source.

suggestions.title: Scheduled re-verification
suggestions.what: Re-check schedules and resort fees on a set cadence (for example weekly during your trip window).
suggestions.benefit: Keeps buy-ins and room status current.
suggestions.effort: Medium. Needs a scheduled job and someone to review changes.

suggestions.title: Show a single-entry-only mode and a full mode
suggestions.what: Toggle between single-entry-only events and all events (with re-entry and add-on rows marked).
suggestions.benefit: Lets you choose between a clean entry plan and a higher-volume plan.

suggestions.title: Add a 'calls to confirm' list
suggestions.what: List each room's phone number and the question to ask, from the official pages.

suggestions.title: Add a cost calculator
suggestions.what: Enter nightly rate, resort fee and tax; get the true cost per night and per stay.
suggestions.benefit: Shows the real cost per stay.

suggestions.title: Keep only official-source links in the main tables
suggestions.what: Move third-party sources to the Flagged for Review page only.
suggestions.effort: Low (already in place for main tables).
